sections.title: What it is
sections.body: Roll a Hope d12 and Fear d12 together, add modifiers, compare to Difficulty.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: The two d12s are rolled together. Their sum plus bonuses determines success against Difficulty. The higher die says whether the result is with Hope or with Fear. Matching dice are a Critical Success.

sections.title: Step by step
items: Use for Action Rolls and most player-facing uncertain rolls.
One sets the total with the other; the higher die colors the result with Hope or Fear.

sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: Roll a Hope d12 and Fear d12 together, add modifiers, compare to Difficulty.
When: Use for Action Rolls and most player-facing uncertain rolls.
Not When: Do not replace this with a custom dice mode in official beginner play.
Question: Why are there two d12s?
Answer: One sets the total with the other; the higher die colors the result with Hope or Fear.
Example: A 10 Fear die plus 5 Hope die with +2 Instinct is 17 with Fear.
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
